ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary File Download Via ConfigSecurityPolicy.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of "ConfigSecurityPolicy.EXE", a binary part of Windows Defender used to manage settings in Windows Defender.
Users can configure different pilot collections for each of the co-management workloads.
It can be abused by attackers in order to upload or download files.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*ConfigSecurityPolicy\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ConfigSecurityPolicy\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ConfigSecurityPolicy\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ftp\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*")))
